string.name: Desc
string.value: Dexterity determines Xenon’s Accuracy and Avoidability, and affects Xenon's attack strength.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Intelligence determines the power and success rate of magic attacks, but does not affect Xenon's attacks.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Luck determines Xenon’s Avoidability, and affects Xenon's attack strength.

string.name: Title
string.value: Morph Gauge

string.name: Desc
string.value: Activate the Dragon Link skill to fill up the Morph Gauge quicker than from using normal skills.\n#cTransfiguration skill effects# will activate, based on how full the Morph Gauge is.

string.name: Title
string.value: Final Transfiguration

string.name: Desc
string.value: Only certain skills can be used while Final Trance is active.

string.name: Desc
string.value: The Battle Monster's level. Basic stats will increase at higher levels, and monsters will have access to more skills.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Reach the EXP target to raise levels. The main Battle Monster will receive EXP when you defeat monsters. Less EXP will be gained if the defeated monster's level is low, and no EXP will be rewarded for hunting monsters that are 20 or more levels below you.

string.name: Desc
string.value: The Battle Monster's max HP. You will lose if your monster's HP reaches 0 first. You can raise this by increasing the monster's level and equipping Battle Monster equipment.

string.name: Desc
string.value: This will determine the damage you deal in battles. You can raise this by increasing the monster's level and equipping Battle Monster equipment.

string.name: Desc
string.value: This will determine the damage you receive in battles. Equip defensive equipment to raise this value.

string.name: Title
string.value: Skill Cost

string.name: Desc
string.value: The cap for your attack and defense skills when you configure Battle Monster skills. The cap will increase as you increase your monster's level.

string.name: Title
string.value: Monster Captured

string.name: Desc
string.value: The total number of Battle Monsters you've captured. The number of Level 60 Battle Monsters will determine the bonus stat given to all Battle Monsters.\r\n+1% to all stats per Level 60 Battle Monster (max +20%)

string.name: Desc
string.value:
Group placement is based on your Ladder Points. Ladder Point requirements are as follows.
Beginner: 1599 or lower
Amateur: 1600 - 1699
Semi-pro: 1700 - 1799
Pro: 1800 - 1899
All-star: 1900 - 1999
Superstar: 2000 - 2199
Legendary: 2200 - 2499
Mythical: 2500 or above

string.name: Title
string.value: Ladder Points

string.name: Desc
string.value: Your League Battle score. You'll start off at 1500 points, and the points will either increase or decrease depending on your victories and losses. You'll earn more points for winning against opponents with more points than you, and lose more points for losing against opponents with less points than you.

string.name: Title
string.value: Battle Charge

string.name: Desc
string.value: You'll use up 1 Battle Charge every time you enter a League Battle. The cap for Battle Charges is 10, and you'll earn 1 every 5 minutes.

string.name: Title
string.value: PVP Cost

string.name: Desc
string.value: Cost for requesting a League Battle with a target. You can fight up to 3 times a day.

string.name: Title
string.value: Unique Ability

string.name: Desc
string.value: Affects Battle Monster stats in battles. Abilities are randomly set when you capture a Battle Monster. Other abilities may be added when you release and recapture the monster. Each Battle Monster will have 2 Unique Abilities.

string.name: Title
string.value: Unique Ability

string.name: Desc
string.value: Affects Battle Monster stats in battles. Abilities are randomly set when you capture a Battle Monster. Other abilities may be added when you release and recapture the monster. Each Battle Monster will have 2 Unique Abilities.

string.name: Title
string.value: Stat ATT

string.name: Desc
string.value: Where the actual Damage is displayed. Magic Attack is displayed when you're equipped with a Wand, Staff, or Shining Road, and Weapon Attack is displayed when you're equipped with other weapons.

string.name: Title
string.value: Critical Activation

string.name: Desc
string.value: Where Critical Rate is displayed. You can enhance this value by using skills or items.
